fields.name: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship Scheme (NMMSS)
fields.provider: Department of School Education & Literacy, Ministry of Education, GoI
fields.description: Centrally sponsored scholarship to provide financial assistance to meritorious students from economically weaker sections to arrest dropouts after class 8 and encourage secondary schooling.
fields.eligibility: Studying in Class 9 in government, local body, or government-aided schools with at least 55% marks in Class 8. Continued till Class 12 upon passing exams.
fields.income_limit: Family income not exceeding Rs 3,50,000 per annum
fields.required_documents: Aadhaar Card, Class 8 Marksheet, Family Income Certificate, Bank Account Details (DBT enabled), School Bonafide Certificate

fields.name: PM Young Achievers Scholarship Award Scheme (PM-YASASVI)
fields.provider: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of India
fields.description: Comprehensive top-class education scholarship scheme for Other Backward Classes (OBC), Economically Backward Classes (EBC), and De-Notified Nomadic Tribes (DNT).
fields.amount: Up to Rs 1,25,000 per annum (Full tuition fees + living allowance)
fields.eligibility: Belong to OBC/EBC/DNT category, studying in identified top-class schools or recognized higher education institutions/universities.
fields.income_limit: Annual family income not exceeding Rs 2,50,000 per annum
fields.course: Class 9 to 12 & Undergraduate Professional Degree Programs
fields.required_documents: Aadhaar Card, Caste/Category Certificate, Income Certificate from competent authority, Admission Fee Receipt, Bank Passbook

fields.name: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarships for College & University Students (CSSS)
fields.provider: Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education, GoI
fields.description: Scholarship awarded to meritorious students from low-income families pursuing regular graduate and post-graduate degree courses in recognized colleges and universities.
fields.amount: Rs 12,000/yr for Graduation; Rs 20,000/yr for Post-Graduation
fields.eligibility: Scored above 80th percentile in relevant stream in Class 12 board exams, pursuing full-time degree program. Not receiving any other central/state scholarship.
fields.income_limit: Gross family income not exceeding Rs 4,50,000 per annum
fields.required_documents: Class 12 Marksheet, College Admission Proof/Bonafide, Aadhaar Card, Income Certificate, Bank Passbook

fields.name: Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme for SC & ST Students
fields.provider: Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment & Ministry of Tribal Affairs, GoI
fields.description: Centrally sponsored scheme providing complete financial support to Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe students studying at post-matriculation or post-secondary stages.
fields.amount: Full compulsory non-refundable fees + monthly maintenance allowance up to Rs 13,500/yr
fields.eligibility: SC or ST community students enrolled in recognized post-matric courses (diploma, degree, master's) in government or accredited private institutions.
fields.income_limit: Annual family income not exceeding Rs 2,50,000 per annum
fields.course: Post-Matric Diploma, Degree, Medical, Engineering, and Professional Courses
fields.required_documents: Caste Certificate, Income Certificate, Previous Year Marksheets, Current Year Fee Structure, Aadhaar Card, Bank Account Details

fields.name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship Scheme for Girl Students
fields.provider: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE), Ministry of Education
fields.description: Empowerment scheme aimed at providing assistance for advancement of girls pursuing technical degree or diploma education in AICTE approved institutions.
fields.amount: Rs 50,000 per annum for every year of study
fields.eligibility: Female student admitted to 1st year of Degree or Diploma course (or 2nd year through lateral entry) in an AICTE approved institution. Maximum 2 girls per family.
fields.income_limit: Family income not exceeding Rs 8,00,000 per annum
fields.course: Engineering, Technology, Architecture, Pharmacy, Diploma in Engineering
fields.required_documents: Class 10 & 12 / ITI Marksheet, AICTE College Allotment Letter, Tuitions Fee Receipt, Family Income Certificate, Aadhaar Card

fields.name: HDFC Bank Parivartan's Educational Crisis Support Scholarship (ECSS)
fields.description: Flagship social initiative to help meritorious students from economically disadvantaged families who are going through personal or financial crises continue their education.
fields.amount: Up to Rs 75,000 per year (covers institutional fees and books)
fields.eligibility: Students enrolled in Class 1 to 12, Diploma, ITI, Undergraduate, or Postgraduate courses who have secured at least 55% marks in prior examinations.
fields.income_limit: Annual family income less than or equal to Rs 2,50,000
fields.course: General & Professional Degree Courses (BA, BSc, BCom, BTech, MBBS, BCA)
fields.required_documents: Previous Year Marksheet, Identity Proof (Aadhaar), Current Year Admission Proof, Crisis Document (if applicable) or Income Certificate, Bank Details

fields.name: Reliance Foundation Undergraduate Scholarship
fields.description: Prestigious scholarship program empowering young students with grants to support undergraduate study in any stream of study across recognized colleges in India.
fields.amount: Up to Rs 2,00,000 for the full duration of undergraduate degree
fields.eligibility: First-year full-time undergraduate students who scored minimum 60% in Class 12 board examination. Includes an aptitude test.
fields.income_limit: Household income up to Rs 15,00,000 (preference given to < Rs 2,50,000)
fields.course: All Undergraduate Degree Streams (Arts, Science, Commerce, Engineering, Law)
fields.required_documents: Class 12 Marksheet, College Bonafide/Admission Letter, Family Income Certificate, Aadhaar Card, Passport Photograph

fields.name: Santoor Women's Scholarship
fields.description: Annual scholarship program dedicated to encouraging and assisting young rural women from underprivileged backgrounds in pursuing higher education.
fields.amount: Rs 24,000 per annum for full 3-year undergraduate course
fields.eligibility: Young women who completed Class 10 from local government school and Class 12 from government junior college, enrolled in first year of recognized 3-year degree.
fields.income_limit: Family income not exceeding Rs 3,00,000 per annum
fields.course: Humanities, Liberal Arts, Sciences, Commerce (B.A., B.Sc., B.Com.)
fields.required_documents: Class 10 & 12 Government School Pass Certificates, Degree College Bonafide/Fee Receipt, Aadhaar Card, Bank Passbook in student's name

fields.name: Kotak Kanya Scholarship
fields.description: Financial assistance program for meritorious girl students from low-income families to pursue professional graduation courses from premier and accredited institutes.
fields.amount: Rs 1,50,000 per year until completion of professional degree
fields.eligibility: Meritorious girl students who scored 75%+ in Class 12 board exams, enrolled in 1st year of professional degree courses (Engineering, MBBS, Architecture, Design, Integrated LLB).
fields.income_limit: Annual family income less than or equal to Rs 6,00,000
fields.course: B.Tech, B.E., MBBS, B.Arch, Integrated 5-Year Law, Design Degree
fields.required_documents: Class 12 Marksheet, Entrance Exam Scorecard (JEE/NEET/CLAT), College Admission Letter & Fee Receipt, Aadhaar Card, Parents' Income Certificate

fields.name: SBI Asha Scholarship Programme
fields.provider: SBI Foundation (CSR arm of State Bank of India)
fields.description: Scholarship initiative to provide financial assistance to top-performing rural and semi-urban students studying in top NIRF-ranked institutions and premier universities.
fields.amount: Rs 50,000 to Rs 2,00,000 per academic year
fields.eligibility: Students pursuing undergraduate or postgraduate courses in top NIRF-ranked institutions, with minimum 75% marks in previous qualifying examination.
fields.income_limit: Gross annual family income up to Rs 3,00,000
fields.course: Bachelors & Masters in Technology, Science, Management, Medicine
fields.required_documents: Previous Academic Marksheets, Admission Letter from Institution, Institutional Fee Receipt, Income Certificate, Aadhaar Card, Student Bank Account Proof

fields.name: Keep India Smiling Foundational Scholarship Programme
fields.description: Foundational educational scholarship to provide foundational support to meritorious students pursuing secondary education, higher secondary, graduation, or vocational training.
fields.eligibility: Students who passed Class 10 or 12 with at least 75% marks and enrolled in Class 11, 12, 3-year graduation, or 1-2 year recognized vocational ITI/polytechnic diploma.
fields.income_limit: Annual household income less than Rs 5,00,000
fields.course: Higher Secondary (10+2), ITI Trades, Polytechnic Diploma, General Graduation
fields.required_documents: Class 10 or 12 Marksheet, Entrance Exam / Admission Letter, Current College/School ID, Income Proof, Aadhaar Card, Disability Certificate (if applicable)

fields.name: Vidyasaarathi Rural Youth Higher Education Scholarship
fields.description: Special corporate CSR education scholarship for young students from rural and farming families pursuing full-time technical diplomas and undergraduate programs.
fields.amount: Up to Rs 40,000 per academic year
fields.eligibility: Students with rural domicile who have completed Class 10/12 with minimum 60% marks and are currently enrolled in recognized full-time diploma or degree programs.
fields.income_limit: Family income not exceeding Rs 4,00,000 per annum
fields.required_documents: Class 10/12 Passing Certificate, Rural Domicile Certificate, Admission Confirmation Letter, Fee Receipt, Aadhaar Card, Bank Passbook

fields.name: PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana
fields.department: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE)
fields.description: National initiative to provide free electricity up to 300 units per month to 1 crore rural and urban households by installing rooftop solar systems with direct central financial assistance.
fields.target_beneficiaries: Rural and urban households with residential electricity connections and suitable rooftop space.
fields.benefits: Direct bank subsidy up to Rs 78,000 for 3kW solar installation, zero electricity bills up to 300 units, and income from selling surplus power back to the grid.
fields.eligibility: Indian citizen, owns a residential house with suitable roof, existing domestic power connection, has not availed any other rooftop solar subsidy.
fields.required_documents: Electricity Bill, Aadhaar Card, Bank Passbook, Roof Ownership Document / NOC, Passport Photo
fields.application_process: Register on pmsuryaghar.gov.in with consumer number, submit rooftop details, choose registered DISCOM vendor, complete net-metering, receive subsidy directly into bank account.

fields.name: PM Vishwakarma Scheme
fields.department: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME)
fields.description: Flagship scheme providing end-to-end support to traditional artisans and craftspeople working with hands and tools across 18 traditional trades in rural and semi-urban India.
fields.target_beneficiaries: Artisans, carpenters, blacksmiths, potters, cobblers, weavers, tailors, sculptors, and traditional craftsmen.
fields.benefits: PM Vishwakarma Certificate & ID Card, basic skill training (5-7 days) with Rs 500/day stipend, toolkit incentive of Rs 15,000, collateral-free enterprise credit up to Rs 3,00,000 at 5% concessional interest.
fields.eligibility: Minimum age 18 years, engaged in one of 18 traditional trades, not availed similar credit loans (PMEGP/Mudra) in last 5 years, restricted to one member per family.
fields.required_documents: Aadhaar Card, Mobile Linked with Aadhaar, Bank Account Passbook, Ration Card / Family Proof
fields.application_process: Register through Common Service Centre (CSC) on pmvishwakarma.gov.in, undergo Gram Panchayat verification, complete skill assessment, and apply for loan tranche.

fields.name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
fields.description: Central sector scheme providing income support to all landholding farmer families across the country to supplement their financial needs for procuring various agricultural inputs.
fields.target_beneficiaries: Small, marginal, and all operational landholder farmer families owning cultivable land.
fields.benefits: Direct cash transfer of Rs 6,000 per annum paid in three equal installments of Rs 2,000 directly into Aadhaar-seeded bank accounts.
fields.eligibility: Landholding farmer family with cultivable land in land records. Excludes institutional landholders, income-tax payers, and constitutional post holders.
fields.required_documents: Aadhaar Card, Land Revenue Records (Khata/Khasra/Patta), Aadhaar-seeded Active Bank Account, e-KYC Verification
fields.application_process: Apply via pmkisan.gov.in portal under 'New Farmer Registration' or visit local Village Revenue Officer (Patwari) / CSC centre. Complete biometric or OTP-based e-KYC.

fields.name: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)
fields.department: Ministry of MSME / Khadi and Village Industries Commission (KVIC)
fields.description: Credit-linked subsidy programme to generate self-employment opportunities through establishment of micro-enterprises in non-farm rural and urban sectors.
fields.target_beneficiaries: Rural youth, aspiring entrepreneurs, self-help groups, and cooperative societies setting up new micro-units.
fields.benefits: Bank-financed project cost up to Rs 50 lakh for manufacturing and Rs 20 lakh for service sector with capital subsidy up to 35% in rural areas for special categories.
fields.eligibility: Individuals aged 18+ years. For projects above Rs 10 lakh in manufacturing or Rs 5 lakh in services, minimum educational qualification is 8th pass.
fields.required_documents: Aadhaar Card, Detailed Project Report (DPR), Educational Certificate, Caste/Special Category Certificate, Rural Area Certificate from Panchayat
fields.application_process: Submit online application with project proposal on kviconline.gov.in/pmegpeportal. Approved projects forwarded to financing bank for sanction and subsidy release.

fields.name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G)
fields.description: National flagship housing mission providing financial assistance to houseless and people living in dilapidated or kutcha houses to build a pucca dwelling unit with clean energy and sanitation.
fields.target_beneficiaries: Rural homeless households and families living in kutcha or dilapidated houses identified via SECC/Awas+ lists.
fields.benefits: Unit financial assistance of Rs 1,20,000 in plain areas and Rs 1,30,000 in hilly/difficult areas, plus 90-95 days of unskilled wage labor under MGNREGA (~Rs 27,000) and Rs 12,000 for toilet under SBM-G.
fields.eligibility: Rural households without pucca house, verified via Gram Sabha and SECC/Awas+ survey data. Priority to SC/ST, women-headed, and disabled individuals.
fields.required_documents: Aadhaar Card, Bank Account Details (DBT enabled), MGNREGA Job Card Number, Land/Homestead Right Certificate
fields.application_process: Beneficiary list prepared by Gram Sabha and verified via Awaas+ app. Geotagged milestone photos at foundation, plinth, and lintel stages trigger direct bank transfers.

fields.name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
fields.description: Comprehensive agricultural insurance scheme providing financial support to farmers suffering crop loss or damage due to non-preventable natural risks, drought, pests, and unseasonal weather.
fields.target_beneficiaries: All farmers including sharecroppers and tenant farmers growing notified crops in notified areas.
fields.benefits: Comprehensive risk coverage from pre-sowing to post-harvest losses. Uniformly low premium: 2% for Kharif crops, 1.5% for Rabi crops, and 5% for commercial/horticultural crops; balance subsidized by Govt.
fields.eligibility: Farmers cultivating notified crops in defined insurance units. Open to both loanee and non-loanee farmers.
fields.required_documents: Aadhaar Card, Land Possession Certificate / RoR / Khasra, Sowing Certificate from Village Revenue Officer / Panchayat, Bank Passbook copy
fields.application_process: Apply through National Crop Insurance Portal (pmfby.gov.in), nearest CSC centre, or local bank branch within the cut-off sowing notification date.

fields.name: Ayushman Bharat - PM Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY)
fields.department: National Health Authority, Ministry of Health & Family Welfare
fields.description: World's largest government-funded health assurance scheme providing cashless secondary and tertiary healthcare coverage to over 12 crore vulnerable rural and urban families.
fields.target_beneficiaries: Bottom 40% vulnerable and economically weak rural families identified as per SECC deprivation criteria.
fields.benefits: Cashless and paperless inpatient treatment up to Rs 5,00,000 per family per year across more than 27,000 empaneled public and private hospitals across India.
fields.eligibility: Families listed in SECC 2011 database or NFSA ration card databases, as well as senior citizens aged 70+ irrespective of income.
fields.required_documents: Aadhaar Card, Ration Card / Family Identification Document, Active Mobile Number
fields.application_process: Check eligibility online at beneficiary.nha.gov.in or visit nearest Ayushman Arogya Mandir / CSC / Hospital Helpdesk to generate Ayushman Card instantly.

fields.name: Mahatma Gandhi NREGA (MGNREGS)
fields.description: Statutory demand-driven wage employment program guaranteeing livelihood security in rural areas by providing at least 100 days of guaranteed wage employment per financial year.
fields.target_beneficiaries: Every rural household whose adult members volunteer to do unskilled manual work on community and individual infrastructure works.
fields.benefits: Statutory wage payment deposited directly into Aadhaar-linked bank/post office account within 15 days; creation of durable rural assets (farm ponds, water conservation, road connectivity).
fields.eligibility: Adult members of rural households willing to do unskilled manual labor. Residing within Gram Panchayat area.
fields.required_documents: Aadhaar Card, Passport size photographs of all adult members, Bank/Post Office Savings Account details
fields.application_process: Submit application to local Gram Panchayat for Job Card issuance. Request employment verbally or in writing; Gram Panchayat issues dated receipt and work allocation within 15 days.

fields.name: Lakhpati Didi Initiative (DAY-NRLM)
fields.description: Special mission under Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - National Rural Livelihoods Mission to enable rural women self-help group (SHG) members to earn a sustainable income of at least Rs 1,00,000 per year.
fields.target_beneficiaries: Rural women organized into Self Help Groups (SHGs) and their Village Organizations.
fields.benefits: Access to community investment funds, bank credit linkage, business mentoring, market linkages, training in high-value agriculture, livestock, drone piloting (Namo Drone Didi), and local retail.
fields.eligibility: Active member of a DAY-NRLM registered Self Help Group for at least 6 months with regular attendance, savings, and internal loan repayments.
fields.required_documents: SHG Member Passbook, Aadhaar Card, Bank Account Details, Livelihood Micro-Plan Copy
fields.application_process: Coordinate with Community Resource Person (CRP) and Cluster Level Federation (CLF) to prepare an individual livelihood enterprise plan.

fields.name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY)
fields.department: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance
fields.description: Scheme to provide collateral-free institutional credit up to Rs 20 lakh to non-corporate, non-farm small and micro enterprises for manufacturing, trading, services, and allied agricultural activities.
fields.target_beneficiaries: Small shopkeepers, rural artisans, food processing units, repair shops, transport operators, and aspiring micro-entrepreneurs.
fields.benefits: Collateral-free loans in 4 categories: Shishu (up to Rs 50,000), Kishore (Rs 50,000 to Rs 5 lakh), Tarun (Rs 5 lakh to Rs 10 lakh), and Tarun Plus (Rs 10 lakh to Rs 20 lakh) at competitive bank rates.
fields.eligibility: Any Indian citizen with a viable business plan for a non-farm income-generating activity, with no history of default with any financial institution.
fields.required_documents: Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, Business Address Proof, Quotation of Machinery / Items to be purchased, Bank statement for last 6 months
fields.application_process: Apply online through JanSamarth portal (jansamarth.in) or visit any Commercial Bank, RRB, Small Finance Bank, or MFI with business project proposal.

fields.name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY)
fields.department: Department of Fisheries, Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry & Dairying
fields.description: Flagship scheme to bring about ecologically sustainable, economically viable Blue Revolution through focused investment in fish production, hatcheries, cold storage, and aquaculture value chain.
fields.target_beneficiaries: Fishers, fish farmers, fish workers, SHGs, JLGs, fisheries cooperatives, and rural youth setting up aquaculture projects.
fields.benefits: Government financial assistance of 40% (general category) and up to 60% (women, SC/ST) on capital investment for new pond construction, biofloc units, recirculatory aquaculture systems (RAS), and refrigerated transport.
fields.eligibility: Individual fish farmers, groups, or enterprises with suitable land or water bodies, or valid lease agreements.
fields.required_documents: Aadhaar Card, Land/Water Body Ownership or Lease Agreement (minimum 7-10 years), Detailed Project Report (DPR), Bank Account Details
fields.application_process: Submit project proposal to the District Fisheries Officer or apply via PMMSY MIS portal (pmmsy.dof.gov.in). Approved proposals receive back-ended subsidy upon project completion.

fields.name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Scheme
fields.department: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare / RBI / NABARD
fields.description: Pioneering financial credit instrument providing adequate and timely credit under a single window to farmers for their cultivation and non-cultivation agricultural requirements, dairy, and fisheries.
fields.target_beneficiaries: All farmers, individual/joint borrowers, tenant farmers, oral lessees, sharecroppers, SHGs or Joint Liability Groups of farmers.
fields.benefits: Revolving credit line up to Rs 3,00,000 at an effective interest rate of 4% per annum (standard 7% minus 3% prompt repayment incentive). No collateral required for loans up to Rs 1,60,000.
fields.eligibility: Owner cultivators or tenant farmers engaged in crop cultivation, dairy farming, poultry, sheep/goat rearing, or fisheries.
fields.required_documents: Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, Land Records (7/12 extract, Khasra/Khatauni) or crop cultivation certificate, Passport photo
fields.application_process: Fill one-page KCC application available on pmkisan.gov.in or any public sector/regional rural bank branch. Banks are mandated to issue KCC within 14 working days.

Farmer holding 2.5 acres dryland requiring crop credit
